pp36_obligations_source_active.name: pp36_obligations_source_active
pp36_obligations_source_active.where: "pp36_obligations"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "pp36_obligations"."source_payment_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL

pp36_obligations_source_line_active.name: pp36_obligations_source_line_active
pp36_obligations_source_line_active.where: "pp36_obligations"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "pp36_obligations"."source_document_line_id" IS NOT NULL

pp36_obligations_source_document_active.name: pp36_obligations_source_document_active
pp36_obligations_source_document_active.where: "pp36_obligations"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "pp36_obligations"."source_document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pp36_obligations"."source_document_line_id" IS NULL

pp36_period_month_check.name: pp36_period_month_check
pp36_period_month_check.value:
"pp36_obligations"."pp36_period_month" >= 1 AND "pp36_obligations"."pp36_period_month" <= 12
      AND ("pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_eligible_period_month" IS NULL OR ("pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_eligible_period_month" >= 1 AND "pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_eligible_period_month" <= 12))
      AND ("pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_expiry_period_month" IS NULL OR ("pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_expiry_period_month" >= 1 AND "pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_expiry_period_month" <= 12))

pp36_reclaim_requires_paid_check.name: pp36_reclaim_requires_paid_check
pp36_reclaim_requires_paid_check.value:
(
        "pp36_obligations"."status" NOT IN ('eligible_for_pp30_reclaim', 'reclaimed_in_pp30')
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_filing_id" IS NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_filing_line_id" IS NULL
      )
      OR (
        "pp36_obligations"."status" = 'eligible_for_pp30_reclaim'
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp36_paid_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp36_filing_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp36_filing_line_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_filing_id" IS NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_filing_line_id" IS NULL
      )
      OR (
        "pp36_obligations"."status" = 'reclaimed_in_pp30'
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp36_paid_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp36_filing_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp36_filing_line_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_filing_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "pp36_obligations"."pp30_reclaim_filing_line_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

pp36_status_links_check.name: pp36_status_links_check
pp36_status_links_check.value:
(
        "pp36_obligations"."status" NOT IN (
          'allocated_to_draft_pp36',
          'pp36_filed',
          'pp36_paid',
          'eligible_for_pp30_reclaim',
          'reclaimed_in_pp30'
        )
        OR ("pp36_obligations"."pp36_filing_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pp36_obligations"."pp36_filing_line_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )
      AND (
        "pp36_obligations"."status" NOT IN ('pp36_paid', 'eligible_for_pp30_reclaim', 'reclaimed_in_pp30')
        OR "pp36_obligations"."pp36_paid_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

sales_transactions_tax_invoice_active_un.name: sales_transactions_tax_invoice_active_uniq
sales_transactions_tax_invoice_active_un.where: "sales_transactions"."tax_invoice_number" IS NOT NULL AND "sales_transactions"."superseded_by_id" IS NULL

tax_treatment_line_active.name: tax_treatment_line_active
tax_treatment_line_active.where: "tax_treatment_decisions"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "tax_treatment_decisions"."source_document_line_id" IS NOT NULL

vat_filing_lines_type_source_check.name: vat_filing_lines_type_source_check
vat_filing_lines_type_source_check.value:
(
        "vat_filing_lines"."line_type" = 'input'
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."vat_input_item_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."vat_output_item_id" IS NULL
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."pp36_obligation_id" IS NULL
      )
      OR (
        "vat_filing_lines"."line_type" = 'output'
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."vat_input_item_id" IS NULL
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."vat_output_item_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."pp36_obligation_id" IS NULL
      )
      OR (
        "vat_filing_lines"."line_type" IN ('pp36_obligation', 'pp36_reclaim')
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."vat_input_item_id" IS NULL
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."vat_output_item_id" IS NULL
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."pp36_obligation_id" IS NOT NULL
      )
      OR (
        "vat_filing_lines"."line_type" IN ('carryforward', 'credit_note_adjustment')
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."vat_input_item_id" IS NULL
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."vat_output_item_id" IS NULL
        AND "vat_filing_lines"."pp36_obligation_id" IS NULL
      )

vat_filings_amounts_nonnegative_check.name: vat_filings_amounts_nonnegative_check
vat_filings_amounts_nonnegative_check.value:
("vat_filings"."output_vat_total" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."output_vat_total" >= 0)
      AND ("vat_filings"."input_vat_total" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."input_vat_total" >= 0)
      AND ("vat_filings"."pp36_vat_total" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."pp36_vat_total" >= 0)
      AND ("vat_filings"."pp36_reclaim_total" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."pp36_reclaim_total" >= 0)
      AND ("vat_filings"."carryforward_in" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."carryforward_in" >= 0)
      AND ("vat_filings"."carryforward_out" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."carryforward_out" >= 0)
      AND ("vat_filings"."refund_amount" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."refund_amount" >= 0)
      AND ("vat_filings"."penalty_amount" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."penalty_amount" >= 0)
      AND ("vat_filings"."surcharge_amount" IS NULL OR "vat_filings"."surcharge_amount" >= 0)

vat_input_items_source_line_active.name: vat_input_items_source_line_active
vat_input_items_source_line_active.where: "vat_input_items"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "vat_input_items"."source_document_line_id" IS NOT NULL

vat_input_claimable_establishment_check.name: vat_input_claimable_establishment_check
vat_input_claimable_establishment_check.value:
"vat_input_items"."status" NOT IN ('claimable', 'allocated_to_draft', 'filed')
      OR "vat_input_items"."establishment_id" IS NOT NULL

vat_input_period_month_check.name: vat_input_period_month_check
vat_input_period_month_check.value:
("vat_input_items"."eligible_period_month" IS NULL OR ("vat_input_items"."eligible_period_month" >= 1 AND "vat_input_items"."eligible_period_month" <= 12))
      AND ("vat_input_items"."expiry_period_month" IS NULL OR ("vat_input_items"."expiry_period_month" >= 1 AND "vat_input_items"."expiry_period_month" <= 12))
      AND ("vat_input_items"."claim_period_month" IS NULL OR ("vat_input_items"."claim_period_month" >= 1 AND "vat_input_items"."claim_period_month" <= 12))

vat_input_claimable_requires_full_tax_in.name: vat_input_claimable_requires_full_tax_invoice_check
vat_input_claimable_requires_full_tax_in.value:
"vat_input_items"."status" NOT IN ('claimable', 'allocated_to_draft', 'filed')
      OR (
        "vat_input_items"."tax_invoice_subtype" IN ('full_ti', 'e_tax_invoice')
        AND "vat_input_items"."tax_invoice_no" IS NOT NULL
        AND "vat_input_items"."tax_invoice_date" IS NOT NULL
      )

vat_input_status_links_check.name: vat_input_status_links_check
vat_input_status_links_check.value:
("vat_input_items"."status" <> 'allocated_to_draft' OR "vat_input_items"."draft_filing_id" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("vat_input_items"."status" <> 'filed' OR "vat_input_items"."filed_filing_line_id" IS NOT NULL)
